Create ONLY ONE SMALL OPEN NOTEBOOK as a separate high-resolution prop; do not output the character, hands, fingers, a pen, a brush, other objects, or a scene. Notebook held upright, front-facing with a very slight three-quarter view, open like a shallow V, two distinct stiff golden-orange covers, subtle gold corner trim, a small elegant qilin-inspired ornamental motif on the front cover, no text, no wordmark, no letters, no whale/DeepSeek/logo. Soft warm light, delicate smooth dark warm brown outlines, same hand-painted orange/gold chibi asset shading as the reference, cute but geometrically consistent, clean antialiased edges and actual transparent background. Fill most of the image with the single notebook and a narrow transparent margin.
